audit_performed.responsive_checks: 320 CSS pixels and text-spacing overrides across100 documents

existing_setup.test_setup: docs/contributing/developing.md Integration tests: wagtail.test.settings_ui, migrate/createcachetable/create disposable admin/runserver; integration dependencies installed separately.
existing_setup.ci: .circleci/config.yml already installs Playwright, starts Django UI test server and runs integration Jest; .github/workflows/test.yml covers backend matrix.
existing_setup.scope_exclusions: editor.test.js currently excludes [aria-describedby^="placeholder-"]; chooser cases are it.skip and exclude .modal. Remove narrowly as defects are fixed, rather than silencing new findings.

test_cases.automated: Extend editor.test.js with a page containing ordinary rich text plus nested/list/StreamField rich text. Assert getByRole(textbox,{name:fieldLabel}) uniquely resolves the visible contenteditable; assert aria-describedby resolves all help/error/counter IDs. Trigger a required/max-length validation error and inspect aria-invalid on the interactive textbox. After fixes remove the global placeholder selector exclusion and rerun axe.
test_cases.manual: With NVDA+Firefox ESR and VoiceOver+Safari, navigate by form controls; each editor announces its label, help, required/error state and error message without navigating to the hidden backing input.

Trigger a required/max-length validation error and inspect aria-invalid on the interactive textbox. After fixes remove the global placeholder selector exclusion and rerun axe.
With NVDA+Firefox ESR and VoiceOver+Safari, navigate by form controls; each editor announces its label, help, required/error state and error message without navigating to the hidden backing input.

ci_recommendation: Extend existing integration job and fixture matrix with state-specific assertions and axe after interaction. Keep failure evidence as artifacts and document bounded exceptions with tracking issue/removal condition. Do not add a second browser/axe pipeline solely for this audit.
limits: The documented project target is WCAG2.1AA; this requested audit uses2.2AA including dragging alternatives and focus-not-obscured.
Automated checks and DOM state probes do not verify actual speech or establish complete conformance.
Use disposable test data on a live backend for saves/uploads/invalid POSTs; no real production mutations were performed.
